question: Which of my accounts have an open high-severity support ticket, and what did they order last quarter?
answer:
## Accounts with Open High-Severity Tickets & Their Q3 2026 Orders

Two of your accounts currently have an **open, high-severity** support ticket — both in the East region and both marked **active**: **Birchwood Foods** and **Evergreen Clinics**. Each has exactly one open high-severity ticket.

| account_id | account_name | region | account_status | open_high_severity_tickets |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A002 | Birchwood Foods | East | active | 1 |
| A005 | Evergreen Clinics | East | active | 1 |

Looking at what they ordered **last quarter (Q3 2026, Jul–Sep)**:

- **Birchwood Foods** placed **4 orders** (Aug 6, Aug 28, Sep 16, Sep 30).
- **Evergreen Clinics** placed **3 orders** (Jul 14, Jul 25, Jul 28).

| account_name | order_id | order_date | amount |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Birchwood Foods | O0085 | 2026-08-06 | None |
| Birchwood Foods | O0102 | 2026-08-28 | None |
| Birchwood Foods | O0111 | 2026-09-16 | None |
| Birchwood Foods | O0119 | 2026-09-30 | None |
| Evergreen Clinics | O0074 | 2026-07-14 | None |
| Evergreen Clinics | O0078 | 2026-07-25 | None |
| Evergreen Clinics | O0082 | 2026-07-28 | None |

Note that the orders table only captures order identifiers, dates, and dollar amounts — there is no product/item-level detail recorded, so "what they ordered" is best represented by order count and timing rather than specific items.

Order **dollar amounts are masked (shown as null)** for both the raw orders table and the `revenue_by_account` metric view — this is expected, since account managers see order activity without revenue figures by design, while finance analysts see the full revenue amounts. This builds on the same accounts you asked about earlier for high-severity tickets, where annual revenue was also found to be unreported for these two accounts. [Open high-severity tickets & revenue](https://<workspace-host>/one/chat/threads/73a5ef9f2e7642418620e9835359025a?o=<workspace-id>)

queries.sql:
SELECT ca.account_id, ca.account_name, ca.region, ca.status AS account_status, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS open_high_severity_tickets
FROM poc.support.tickets t
JOIN poc.sales.customer_accounts ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.severity = 'high'
GROUP BY ca.account_id, ca.account_name, ca.region, ca.status
ORDER BY ca.account_name

SELECT ca.account_name, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.amount
FROM poc.sales.orders o
JOIN poc.sales.customer_accounts ca ON o.account_id = ca.account_id
WHERE o.account_id IN ('A002','A005')
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-10-01'
ORDER BY ca.account_name, o.order_date

SELECT `account_id`, `account_name`, `order_quarter_label`, MEASURE(`revenue`) AS revenue, MEASURE(`order_count`) AS order_count
FROM poc.sales.revenue_by_account
WHERE `account_id` IN ('A002','A005') AND `order_quarter_label` = '2026-Q3'
GROUP BY ALL
